behavior: Invoices, Activity and Transactions filter and search on the server, so a match on an older page shows without loading every page
acceptance: GET /v1/profiles/{id}/invoices, /activity and /transactions take the page's filter (invoice status: open, paid, settled, expired; transaction direction: in, out) and a search text (invoice number, title, client name or email, amount, address, transaction hash) and return only matching rows with the same cursor paging; empty or too-long search is a 422; queries use indexes (EXPLAIN on a seeded DB recorded in the proof); openapi.yaml and api.md list the parameters; Go tests on real Postgres cover each filter, search, and paging through a filtered list

The web sends filter and search to the API (search waits about 300 ms after typing and cancels the older request) instead of filtering loaded rows; a match that sits beyond the first page shows on the first load; 'Show more' continues the filtered list; the URL keeps filter and search so reload and Back keep them; empty results say nothing matched and offer to clear; Playwright covers a match beyond the first page on each of the three pages
notes: 2026-10-11 review pass by reviewer: PASS after one fix. Go tests -race pass; dynamic SQL only joins constants and placeholders, LIKE escaping proven, numeric amount search cannot 500; keyset cursors with plain WHERE filters page filtered lists without gaps or repeats; status buckets identical to the removed web helpers; pg_trgm index expression equals searchText and the custom plan uses it; no stale answers shown; no ?search= left. FIXED: Back after a link changed ?q on the same page kept the later search and rewrote ?q (useListFilters now records outside changes as written; new unit test fails on the old code); intQuery doc comment restored; down migration keeps pg_trgm.

proof.1: backend: GET /invoices, /activity and /transactions take status (open|paid|settled|expired) or direction (in|out) and q, applied in SQL before the cursor (internal/invoice/list.go, internal/activity, internal/search). Tests on real Postgres (internal/httpapi/list_search_test.go, internal/search/search_test.go): every filter, search per field (number, title, note, client name and email, receive address, settle and deposit tx hash, counterparty, symbol, exact amount incl. 1,250.50 and too many decimals), filter+search together, each case paged one item per page through the filtered list, 422 for q blank/101 chars/unknown status or direction, 100 chars OK, Bob 403. Amount: a decimal q matches amount = q*10^decimals in Postgres numeric, exact. Index: migration 00014 adds pg_trgm GIN on the invoice search text. EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a scratch DB (120,000 invoices, 60,000 deposits, 120,000 transfers; one profile with 20,000 invoices and 20,000 transfers): invoice search matching nothing 45.3 ms before -> 0.02 ms after (Bitmap Index Scan on invoices_search, also in the generic plan), one old client 2.4 ms, common word 0.06 ms (ordered profile index), status filter 0.04-0.09 ms; a numeric q also compares amounts, no index: 38-41 ms at 20,000 invoices. Activity and transactions already read all of the profile's rows to sort them (no filter 35-94 ms and 8-14 ms); with filter/search 11-40 ms and 4-28 ms, so no index added there. openapi.yaml and docs/backend/api.md list status, direction and q.
proof.2: e2e: e2e/privy/sign-in.spec.ts 'Invoices, Activity and Transactions filter and search on the API' on a mocked API that honours status, direction, q and cursor with 45-row lists: INV-0003 (43rd), a payment (41st) and a transfer (41st) each show on the first load of the search; typing 'zephyr' sends one request after the last key; the URL keeps ?q= and ?status=/?direction= across reload and Back from an invoice; 'Show more' continues the searched list (20 -> 40); no match says so and 'Clear filter and search' restores the list; axe has no serious or critical violation on the no-match state. The existing app-pages test passes with the server-side filters. Web: useListFilters (shared/hooks) keeps filter and search in the URL with a 300 ms wait; the lists show only the answer for the current filter (RTK currentData, useShownData), so an older request's answer never shows; client filter helpers removed; unit tests for withParam and apiSearch.; unit: use-list-filters.test.ts 'follows Back to an earlier search after a link changed ?q, and never writes the later one again' (fails before the fix: field kept 0xhash and rewrote ?q)
